text_block_list.text:
Come now, go search...
Right now... it's time to start...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—And that was the dream I had!
It's without a doubt a divine sign proclaiming
"Today is the lucky day to unlock the secret art"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mysterious paper found in Matikanefukukitaru's family home—
It seems she is still investigating its true nature.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I've already prepared countermeasures via Shiraoki-sama flower divination!
I certainly don't want to get dragged to the student council again!
And the fortune said—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Borrowing the strength of friends brings fortune"!
...W-Well... having caused trouble everywhere earlier,
that part might actually be the hardest...

Ah, then in your hour of greatest need...
I, the radiant sun, shall extend my hand!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If companions to dash alongside you on a grand journey
of exploration are what you desire, that is!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! Fukukitaru-san, you helped give me
advice during the karuta tournament...
...S-So please... let me return the favor!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehem! Now that Urara and the gang are here,
you can rest easy! Let's solve this riddle together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: E-Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Is this the ritual diagram...?
Let's see, pictures, numbers, and...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Bell" 20, "Dancing person" 3, "Flower" 0,
...and then a fish, a "Carp"...
I don't understand any of this at all~...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Haaahaha!
This is a scene from a tale of interspecies romance!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in a meadow of blessed "Flowers", I shall let you hear
the chimes of angelic "Bells" as they sing and "Dance" of love!
Even if it is with a "Carp", it matters not—
choice_data_list: I'm pretty sure that's not it...?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, what are these numbers written here?
Let's see, 20, 3...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auu... We can't solve it...
Is there no salvation for us at all...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Bell", "Dancing person", "Flower", "Carp"...
............Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! All of these are at my family's house!
The bell rope, the kagura dance stage, the flower decorations, and the carp pond...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There is salvation after all~...!
Then what do the numbers mean...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —"The number of steps from there to the hint, silly."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I remember now... This is...
A treasure map... Big Sister made for me...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Back when I was first learning to write...
She told me it was number practice... and played with me.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um... If I remember correctly, that... your sister was...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, she passed away long ago.
So long ago that my memories grew this hazy.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad!
A mysterious secret art turned into
precious memories with Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I were alone, it never would have turned out this way~!
I would've just run around screaming "What ritual is this?!"
and doing all the wrong things...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you so much!
My heart feels so warm! This truly is a grand finale!
choice_data_list: The treasure itself is still a mystery, though!
The treasure itself is still a mystery, you know!
Make sure to take good care of that map.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... thank you so much!
My heart feels so warm! This truly is a grand finale!
choice_data_list: The treasure itself is still a mystery, though!
The treasure itself is still a mystery, you know!
Make sure to take good care of that map.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! The grand finale is not yet upon us!
Come, let us see this through to the very end together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... You're right! In that case,
I'll gladly take you all up on that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's... true... My treasure hunt with
Big Sister isn't over yet, is it...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...All right!
From here on, I'll try searching for it on my own.
Just like when I was little!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes~... Um, I'll be rooting for you
as you search for your memories with your sister...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I heard back from her after she returned home.
Though the mystery remains unsolved, she found plenty of letters
and maps exchanged with her sister from those cherished days...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! So that I never, ever
forget about them again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, your big sister must be smiling right now too!
Big smiles for both Fuku-chan and her~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru clutches the treasured map dearly to her chest.
Seeing the brilliant smile on her face fills me with energy as well.
